records.groupTitle: Immunisation Coverage For Children At 2 Years Of Age By Sex
records.title: Immunisation Coverage For Children At 2 Years Of Age By Sex, Annual
records.footnote: Refers to immunisation coverage for children at 2 years of age who are Singapore citizens and permanent residents.

row.footnote: Immunisation coverage for BCG refers to children who received the birth dose of BCG vaccine.
Immunisation coverage for diphtheria refers to children who received at least three doses of diphtheria-containing vaccine.
Immunisation coverage for poliomyelitis refers to children who received at least three doses of polio-containing vaccine.
Immunisation coverage for hepatitis B refers to children who received at least three doses of hepatitis B-containing vaccine.
Immunisation coverage for measles refers to children who received at least one dose of measles-containing vaccine.
